answer: HireEdge Consultancy is a fictional recruitment firm that connects skilled candidates with growing companies.
We offer permanent hiring, contract staffing, executive search and campus hiring.
We hire for IT, finance, healthcare, retail, education and construction clients.
Our head office is in Chennai, with branch offices in Bengaluru and Hyderabad.
For employers we charge 8.33% of the annual CTC on successful placement. Job seekers are never charged.
Our process: understand the client need, source candidates, screen and shortlist, schedule interviews, then support the offer and joining.
We usually share the first set of shortlisted profiles within 5 to 7 working days.
Job seekers can register for free by emailing their resume to jobs@hireedge.example.
Employers can share a job requirement at clients@hireedge.example and we respond within one working day.
Our office is open Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM.
